long_biography.plain_text:
The Obermaier Immobiliengruppe buys and develops property chiefly for long-term ownership. From its Munich base, it focuses on complex commercial parks and residential developments, pairing sustainable planning with economic building management to preserve value within the portfolio.

Obermaier's corporate role extends through Limax property businesses. Erich Matthias Obermaier of Grünwald is managing director of LIMAX Facility Management and related property entities at the same Munich address. He is also the sole shareholder of LIMAX Facility Management. The position combines ownership with management of a company providing commercial, technical and infrastructure services to property assets.
